workstreams.name: Blueprint hypotheses
workstreams.answers: What must hold true about each component of the platform for small Iberian shippers to adopt it?
activities: Frame the blueprint components of the platform
Write testable hypotheses for each blueprint component
Align on scope and hypotheses with key stakeholders

workstreams.name: Shipper and market evidence
workstreams.answers: How do small shippers in Iberia buy freight today, and does the evidence support each hypothesis?
activities: Interview small shippers on how they arrange freight
Analyze market data and documents on Iberian freight demand
Test each hypothesis against the evidence gathered

workstreams.name: Platform prototype
workstreams.answers: What should a small shipper see and do on the platform to get freight matched?
activities: Draft wireframes of the shipper journey
Build a clickable wireframe prototype
Test the prototype with small shippers

workstreams.name: Blueprint and pilot plan
workstreams.answers: What blueprint, tested against the hypotheses, and what plan for the pilot go to the go/no-go decision?
activities: Assemble the blueprint from the tested hypotheses
Define pilot scope, milestones and launch criteria
Review the plan with the CEO, CTO and Head of Sales

workstreams.name: Pilot KPIs and enablement
workstreams.answers: What KPIs, internal roles and stakeholder agreements does the pilot need to track progress toward 200 active shippers?
activities: Agree pilot KPIs with the CEO, CTO and Head of Sales
Identify the internal hires the pilot needs
Report pilot KPI progress to the stakeholders

workstreams.name: First shipper group
workstreams.answers: Which group of small shippers should the pilot launch to first?
activities: Analyze shipper segments using the Design phase evidence
Interview small shippers on whether they would join
Select the first target group for launch

workstreams.name: Platform build and pilot
workstreams.answers: Can the first version be built, launched to the first shipper group and reach 200 active shippers?
activities: Build the first version and prepare it for launch
Launch to the first group, then onboard more shippers
Collect usage data and shipper feedback during the pilot

workstreams.name: Scale-up business case
workstreams.answers: What business case, implementation plan and roadmap does the pilot evidence support for scaling the platform?
activities: Analyze pilot usage data against the 200-shipper target
Build the business case and implementation plan
Draft the roadmap with the CEO, CTO and Head of Sales
